body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Motorola introduced its mountable digital picture frame ´LS420´ at CES 2010.
It features 4.2" diagonal TFT dual screens (234*202 pixels each), programmable on/off time, clock and calendar functions, memory card slot-SD, SDHC, MMC and mini USB port.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
